Nutrigenomics and epigenetics are two fancy words that have circulated around the world of medicine for decades. If you see a functional or an integrative health practitioner, you may be familiar with one or both of these words.
Epigenetics is a term that is used to identify how the environment interacts with our genes. Epigenetic research has shown that our lifestyle choices, our environment, and our exposure to toxins can actually impact how genes are expressed.
According to Psychology Today, “One major type of epigenetic mechanism, called DNA methylation, occurs when molecules called methyl groups attach to certain pieces of DNA, which can affect a gene's activity, turning its expression ‘on’ or ‘off.’
